title: Maintaining Proper Slope in Drainage Lines
description: Achieving correct pitch on horizontal drainage pipe runs is critical for self-scouring flow. If a pipe lacks sufficient slope, liquid velocity slows down, leaving heavy solids and grease behind to accumulate and cause blockages. Conversely, excessive slope can lead to improper flow dynamics and code compliance issues. Additionally, failing to support drainage piping at required intervals causes sag or 'bellies' in the line where standing water collects. Always follow local plumbing codes for slope requirements and install proper pipe hangers to maintain a continuous, unyielding pitch along the entire run.

Maintaining Proper Slope in Drainage Lines

Achieving correct pitch on horizontal drainage pipe runs is critical for self-scouring flow. If a pipe lacks sufficient slope, liquid velocity slows down, leaving heavy solids and grease behind to accumulate and cause blockages. Conversely, excessive slope can lead to improper flow dynamics and code compliance issues. Additionally, failing to support drainage piping at required intervals causes sag or 'bellies' in the line where standing water collects. Always follow local plumbing codes for slope requirements and install proper pipe hangers to maintain a continuous, unyielding pitch along the entire run.
